result:
I fixed all three webhook problems. Type-check and the full test suite (617 tests) pass, but I didn't add a test for any of the three cases.

1. **Switching off didn't stick** (`src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts`): the endpoint update only saved the on/off setting when it was "on", so "off" was silently dropped. It now saves whichever value is sent. The code that queues new events already skips switched-off endpoints, so nothing new is queued for them once "off" is saved.
2. **Old queued deliveries still went out** (`src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts`): when the delivery run reaches a delivery whose endpoint is switched off, it now marks it failed ("endpoint is disabled") and adds it to the failed count. Missing endpoints were already marked failed, and endpoints that are on are delivered as before.
3. **Switched-off endpoints didn't count toward the plan** (`src/server/services/webhook-service.ts`): the check when creating an endpoint now counts all of the workspace's endpoints, on or off. A workspace at its limit is refused whether or not one is switched off.
